h1: Steve Drake closes Michelin-starred Sorrel in Dorking
title: Steve Drake Closes Michelin-Starred Sorrel in Dorking
description: Steve Drake closed Sorrel in Dorking, Surrey, with immediate effect on 28 July 2026, saying rising costs meant the figures no longer worked.
summary: Surrey’s Sorrel closed overnight after nine years, its chef blaming higher National Insurance, the minimum wage rise and falling covers.
body:
Sorrel, Steve Drake’s MICHELIN-starred restaurant in Dorking, Surrey, closed with immediate effect on 28 July 2026, nine years after it opened in a Grade II-listed 18th-century building. Drake said the figures no longer worked; the restaurant had been up for sale since May.

Why Sorrel closed

Drake told The Staff Canteen that higher employer’s National Insurance, April’s minimum wage rise and reduced business rates relief had piled up, and that covers had fallen to about 80 a week against the 150 to 200 it needed. About ten full-time and six part-time staff lost their jobs.

Where to find a starred meal in Surrey now

Our Surrey Michelin star restaurants page lists the county’s starred restaurants with their prices, and keeps Sorrel under “No longer starred”. The year’s other closures are in our guide to UK Michelin star restaurants that closed.
